title: The Crow and the Pitcher
author: Aesop
summaryZh: 当水就在眼前却喝不到，乌鸦想出了什么办法？

vocabulary.noteZh: perishing with thirst：渴得快要死了
all his efforts were in vain：所有努力都白费了
within his reach：在他能够到的范围内

questions.prompt: Why can the crow not drink at first?
options: The water is too low to reach.
questions.explanation: 原文说 it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it，说明水位低到乌鸦够不着；没有说水太热或水罐没有开口。
hints: 题目问最初喝不到水的原因，不是后来采用的办法。
在第 1 段找 When he reached it 后的发现，留意 so ... that ... 表示的程度与结果。
questions.evidence: When he reached it, he discovered to his grief that it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it.

evidenceSpans.text: When he reached it, he discovered to his grief that it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it.

questions.prompt: What does the crow put into the pitcher?
questions.explanation: At last 后写 collected as many stones ... and dropped them ... into the pitcher。them 指前面的 stones，即石子，不是树叶或沙子。
hints: 定位乌鸦最后采取的行动，找 collected 和 dropped。
第 1 段 At last 后，them 指回 collected 的宾语；核对它是哪一种物品。

text:
A CROW perishing with thirst saw a pitcher, and hoping to find water, flew to it with delight. When he reached it, he discovered to his grief that it contained so little water that he could not possibly get at it. He tried everything he could think of to reach the water, but all his efforts were in vain. At last he collected as many stones as he could carry and dropped them one by one with his beak into the pitcher, until he brought the water within his reach and thus saved his life.

Necessity is the mother of invention.
